## About
Karzus auto center is a car repair shop on S Post Oak Rd in Houston. We take care of mechanical problems, and we also do body work, paint and collision repair, so your car can get everything it needs in one place.
We sell vehicles too. Stop by during the week or on Saturday, or give us a call to talk through what your car needs.

## Services
- Mechanical repairs: General car repair and maintenance for everyday drivers.
- Paint and collision: Auto body work, from paint to collision damage.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do body work as well as mechanical repairs?
A: Yes. We handle mechanical repairs and also do auto body work, including paint and collision.

Q: What are your hours during the week?
A: Monday through Friday we're open 9 AM to 6 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 14300 S Post Oak Rd, Houston, TX 77045.
